name: Neighbour List Octree Traversal
definition: An octree traversal algorithm that uses a precomputed list of neighbouring cells for each cell wall to efficiently find the next cell crossed by a photon ray, avoiding expensive geometric intersection tests with all potential neighbours.
summary: Neighbour List Octree Traversal is a ray-tracing method that determines the next intersected cell by consulting precomputed lists of adjacent cells, avoiding geometric intersection tests and reducing traversal cost.
